reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I have this app on my television and it is absolutely wonderful to be able to listen to my favorite radio stations through my television. When I found it here on my phone, I thought it was going to be wonderful however it wasn’t. I was very disappointed to find that I had ads that would pop up and interrupt the radio station and pop up over my traffic reports in local areas. During Talk Radio, I would miss half the interesting parts because of an ad and then have to listen to the ads on the radio station itself. And then I find in order to stop the ads I have to pay almost 60 bucks to listen to a radio station that is free on the air. I’d rather listen to static then have to pay that.

reviews.title: Aggressive Ads refuse to clear away
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for a while, and have always b en irritated by how forceful the ads are, but hoped it would improve over time. The minute to open the app, ads will appear, that you can’t get it of. You wait a few seconds, and an X will appear, but here’s the trick, you try to press the X, and it won’t allow you to close the ad, instead, it sends you to a link or to the play store to download the advertised application. This will happen exactly 3 times before it allows you to finally click the X. I’ve confined the ads are not simply time sensitive, so it won’t just simply allow you to close them if y let them play. They specifically require too tool to click on the X three times, and each time will send you on a link, before finally allowing you to close out. This is extremely aggressive and not worth it in my opinion. Find another app to use

reviews.title: Charged Anyway after Cancellation!
reviews.text:
I needed to tune into local radio in my area, so I downloaded this tuner with the option to cancel after a trial period. I canceled the next day thinking we were good. 

Two weeks later, I’m charged $34.99, and I log into my subscriptions, and it shows I’ve canceled the subscription and the date, way before this charge occurred. 

I contacted Apple, and they refunded my money the next day. I’d be careful with an app that promises one thing and then pulls rug out from under you the next.

reviews.title: What did you do?!
reviews.text:
I LOVED this app. I need music for my exceptional  neuro-differences, daily, and this WAS my go to over all other apps including Spotify. 

Well I updated the app and now:
1 - as soon as I turn it to a new station I get a pop up EVERY TIME asking if I want to add it to favorites. I mean, I just opened the goddamn thing and don’t even know if I like it yet. Can I get through a commercial first?!

2 - EVERY station completely stops playing for no reason, every 30 seconds. Useless. 

So so so disappointed.

reviews.title: STAY AWAY!!!
reviews.text: This is the only app I've felt compelled to warn folks NOT to even try. The ads are not simply intrusive. Many are set up to completely take over your entire screen until you go to the app store and purchase whatever's being advertised. Never seen anything like this. I've tried over half a dozen of these radio apps at this point. 'I Heart Radio' was the best overall. But If you also want more obscure stations (college or thing public), 'Simple Radio' is a good alternative. Both have free and paid versions.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: This used to be a much better app.  Now, however, and for quite a while, it seems to randomly select a station for  me but not from my favorites.  That, at least, would make sense.  Instead, it may pick for me some station I’ve never played before, have never heard of,  and which I may really dislike and will make it difficult for me to navigate back to the main page.  Moreover, the ads often now cover the full screen, which will also block my ability to get to that main screen.  I understand it’s a free app and they are trying to monetize as much as possible. But I much prefer the smaller banner-type ads that used to appear, because what they are doing now gets in the way of the usability.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: They used the iHeart platform and it's the worst! If you listen to live radio, they insert prerecorded commercials and playlists they think you'll like. Problem is, they stop the live radio and you miss important information like local news, and announcements. I think they're trying to avoid commercials, but they don't just cut off commercials, they cut off talk radio shows, the breakfast club specifically, and i spend the majority of my morning stopping and starting the app trying to get back to the live station I chose. Terrible app.
